wants: Keep boats away from the broken reef.
npcs.name: Harbormaster Elin
knowledgeLimits: Elin did not go up to the lighthouse during the storm.

npcs.name: Keeper Mara
knowledgeLimits: Mara was sheltering in the lantern room when the surveyor vanished.

replies.text: Mara: I saw Tovin take the green survey lamp toward the eastern cove. He said the tide marks would prove the reef had shifted.
Mara: I have said enough. If you want proof, search the beacon log in the lantern room.
Mara: Bring me a reason to trust you; the storm has made every question sound like an accusation.
Mara: The lantern room is open. Do not touch the cracked lens.

wants: Recover the nets blown into the cove.
npcs.name: Fisher Oren
knowledgeLimits: Oren arrived after dawn and did not see the surveyor.

wants: Salvage usable brass from the storm wreckage.
npcs.name: Wright Sella
knowledgeLimits: Sella has not crossed the flooded path to the cove.

monsterDefinitions.name: reef crab

facts.statement: Mara saw Tovin carry a green survey lamp toward the eastern cove before the worst gusts struck.

fates.text: Tovin's route is reconstructed from the ledger and the beacon log; the harbor can mount a focused search before the next tide.
The reef measurements are secured, so no other boat will follow the shifted channel by mistake.

narration.text: Elin rings the harbor bell and sends a search boat along the eastern cove at once.

consequences.text: The harbor launches a daylight search for Tovin.

narration.text: Sella copies the safe route onto a fresh chart while Oren carries it to the fishing crews.

consequences.text: A warning chart is posted for every crew using the harbor.

title: The Green Lamp at Reefward
objective: Trace the missing surveyor's route through the storm-damaged lighthouse and choose how the harbor responds.

discoveries.title: Storm warning
discoveries.lead: The bulletin names Reefward Lighthouse as the last place the surveyor was expected to report.
discoveries.summary: Tovin, a harbor surveyor, failed to return after checking the storm-shifted reef.

discoveries.title: Surveyor's route
discoveries.lead: The final entry directs you to compare the lighthouse beacon log with the eastern-cove tide marks.
discoveries.summary: Tovin planned to test a newly exposed passage marked by a green lamp.

discoveries.title: Beacon log entry
discoveries.lead: The log records the green signal's timing and provides the evidence needed to act at the quay.
discoveries.summary: The beacon log confirms that a green survey signal flashed toward the eastern cove after the storm began.

discoveries.title: Shifted tide mark
discoveries.lead: The painted stake shows where the reef channel has moved.
discoveries.summary: The tide stake proves that the former safe channel now runs over a sharp reef shelf.

discoveries.title: Spare signal lamp
discoveries.lead: A repaired lamp could guide searchers through the mist.
discoveries.summary: The repair shed holds a working green signal lamp with fresh oil.

introduction: Surveyor Tovin vanished while charting a reef exposed by last night's storm. His last scheduled report was from Reefward Lighthouse.

searches.text: The blurred bulletin identifies Tovin and notes his planned lighthouse report.
The ledger's final page maps Tovin's intended signal route and records the eastern cove as his next station.
A precise entry records a green lamp flashing three times toward the eastern cove after midnight.
The stake's fresh paint and skewed position show that the reef channel has shifted east.
Behind the hooks, you find an oil-filled green signal lamp ready for use.
